persona.bio: Office coordinator for an office of about 70 people. In her own words: I am an office coordinator for an office of about 70 people. I prepare and organize lunch for everyone. I order drinks, restock the fridges and keep the office clean and organized. I take care of the plants and general maintenance. I handle special orders and preparations for company events. I coordinate suppliers and make sure we have what we need. I am the person everyone comes to when something is missing or needs fixing. If the printer runs out of ink I find a replacement, and if we have none I order more. She works in Outlook, Teams and Excel, on a computer and on her phone. Lunch for the whole office and keeping the fridges stocked take the most time. She is new to AI and has never really used it. She is an employee and is not sure what her company allows.
